summary: Execute approved native Paxlet actions through Taskand shell

delivery.outcome: Explicit digest-pinned local execution of an approved native catalog action through the bounded shell process API, with a fresh preserved execution workspace and Paxlet receipt.
nonGoals: Remote catalog approval or execution grants
Changing the native catalog schema or Paxlet runtime

architecture.decision: Resolve the caller-selected action and exact digest against the operator's local catalog, materialize verified bytes outside the immutable Paxlet store into a fresh run-ID workspace, and invoke the existing Paxlet action runtime with its digest check. Preserve the workspace and receipt; never re-execute an existing run ID.
interfaceChanges: Opt-in process run_catalog operation with selector, action, expected_digest and fresh run ID
architecture.rollback: Stop using run_catalog; retain prior local catalog and execution receipts without deleting workspaces. Existing shell operations are unchanged.

validation.evidence: Real Paxlet store/materialization and local catalog approval/withdrawal cases, exact-head governance and hosted protected checks
